results.title: Tesla’s Q2 sales jump 25 percent | The Verge
excerpts:
Q2 sales jump 25 percent The company said that it produced a total of 451,758 vehicles between April and June of this year, including 442,936 Model 3 and Model Y vehicles, as well as 8,822 “other vehicles” like the Cybertruck and the Tesla Semi. (The company discontinued the Model S and X earlier this year.) That represents about a 10 percent increase compared to the second quarter of 2025, when the company produced 410,244 vehicles. Tesla also said that it delivered a total of 480,126 vehicles, including 467,762 Model 3 and Model Y vehicles, as well as 12,364 other vehicles — about a 25 percent increase compared to the second quarter of 2025, when it delivered 384,122 vehicles.
